question: Should OpenClaw fail closed before `sessions_send` delivery when propagated inter-agent provenance shows the target agent already participated in the current route?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but it intentionally changes existing cyclic multi-agent routes from delivered work into errors, which requires maintainer product and compatibility intent before merge.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
options.body: Land the visited-agent provenance guard after proof and cleanup so A -> B -> C -> A routes stop before the repeated agent run.

options.title: Preserve cyclic revisits
options.body: Reject or rework the guard if legitimate workflows must revisit an agent in the same route without a tool error.

options.title: Require explicit route policy
options.body: Ask for an opt-in or thresholded route policy if maintainers want protection without changing revisit behavior by default.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
recommendation.body: Land the visited-agent provenance guard after proof and cleanup so A -> B -> C -> A routes stop before the repeated agent run.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed history across inter-session provenance, A2A policy, and session-tool delivery boundaries.
